docs.title: Commands List
docs.text:
Below is a list of all relevant commands for the addonpack.

Note, not all of these commands are accessible without cheats enabled / Operator rights.

docs.title: Superpower Commands:
docs.text:
/superpower add fsang:powername @

  • This command can be used to add powers to any player. Just replace the @ with the name of the player.

docs.text: This page will contain everything you will need to play with Fsang18's Heropack. Everything you need should be put in your "mods" folder.

docs.title: DNA Recoding Chamber
docs.text:
Multiblock Structure DNA Recoding Chamber

A multiblock structure made from three different blocks, used to equip and unequip powers.

TypeMultiblock Parts3 Blocks Size2 Wide, 2 High

docs.title: Parts
docs.text: Power BlockThe base DNA Transfer StationThe terminal ChamberThe glass pod

docs.title: Building It
docs.text:
1. Craft a Power Block, a DNA Transfer Station and a Chamber.
  2. Place the Power Block down.
  3. Place the DNA Transfer Station on top of the Power Block.
  4. Place the Chamber right next to them, so the two columns stand side by side.

docs.title: Equipping and Removing Powers
docs.text:
1. Put the vial of the power into the plus square of the DNA Transfer Station. To remove a power, use an empty vial instead.
  2. Enter the Chamber and close the door of the machine.
  3. Hit Start when ready.

The Power Block holds the power the machine runs on, up to 100,000.

docs.title: DNA Transfer Station
docs.text:
This is where you insert the vials, be it empty or full. It also shows:

  • The power you currently have equipped.
  • A green bar that shows the power stored in the multiblock.

docs.title: Access Modes
docs.text:
The DNA Transfer Station has 3 access modes:

PublicEveryone can use it. PrivateOnly the user of the multiblock can use it. UserOnly the player whose name is typed in the section below the access bar can use it.

docs.title: Main Powers
docs.text:
"Main Powers" is a term used to describe powers obtainable that cannot be stacked with each other. Most of these powers can be paired with Secondary Powers but no two main powers can be paired with each other naturally.

Main powers are grouped by the universe they come from. Pick one to see its categories.

docs.title: Marvel
docs.text: Spider-powered heroes, mutants, gods and cosmic beings from the Marvel universe.

docs.title: DC
docs.text: Kryptonians, Amazons, speedsters and other heroes from the DC universe.

docs.title: DC
docs.text: DC characters draw their abilities from alien heritage, myth, speed, magic and advanced science. Here you can find all the information about powers from DC.

docs.title: Kryptonians
docs.text: Heroes from Krypton, with flight, super strength and heat vision.

docs.title: Metahumans
docs.text: Humans with extraordinary abilities from metagene activation, mutations or unusual energies.

docs.title: Kryptonians
docs.text:
Kryptonians are a humanoid extraterrestrial species originating from the planet Krypton. Under a yellow sun, they develop extraordinary abilities, including superhuman strength, speed, flight, enhanced senses, and near-invulnerability. Their powers vary depending on their individual traits, exposure to different solar levels, and the universe they originate from. Here you can find all the variants and information regarding them.

Kryptonian – AbsoluteOffenseFighterMobilitySensorySAdventuresPage coming soonCWPage coming soonDCEUPage coming soon

Focus your eyes to zoom in on distant things. Scroll up to zoom in further and down to zoom back out while it is on.

docs.title: Weaknesses
docs.text:
Kryptonite

If this power is near or hit by kryptonite, it will contract kryptonite poison, starting from level I and growing to level V from continuous contact. This rapidly drains your Solar energy. Once your Solar energy is drained, your hunger will start to deplete and you will begin taking damage. Kryptonite crystals will also grow over your body.

Poison Level I to VDrains Solar energyThen Hunger and damage

docs.title: Metahumans
docs.text:
Metahumans are individuals in the DC Universe who possess extraordinary abilities, often resulting from genetic mutations, metagene activation, or exposure to unusual energies and substances. Their powers vary widely, including superhuman strength, enhanced senses, elemental control, energy manipulation, technology control, and other unique abilities.

Technopathy Page coming soon

docs.title: Marvel
docs.text: Marvel characters possess a wide range of extraordinary abilities, often gained through genetic mutations, scientific experiments, advanced technology, exposure to radiation, or other supernatural and cosmic phenomena. Their powers vary greatly, including superhuman strength, enhanced senses, energy manipulation, elemental control, and a variety of unique abilities. Here you can find all the information about powers from Marvel.

docs.title: Arachnids
docs.text: Spider-powered heroes with wall-crawling, enhanced senses and web-based abilities.

docs.title: Mutants
docs.text: Powers granted by the X-Gene, from telepathy and telekinesis to reality warping.

docs.title: Inhumans
docs.text: Powers awakened by the Terrigen Mist, from elemental control to enhanced strength.

docs.title: Arachnids
docs.text:
Arachnids are individuals who possess spider-like abilities, typically gained through exposure to radioactive or genetically altered spiders. Their powers commonly include enhanced strength, speed, agility, wall-crawling, and a spider-sense that warns them of danger. Depending on the individual, they may also possess unique abilities such as organic webbing, venom blasts, camouflage, or enhanced biological traits. Here you can find all the information about arachnid powers.

Arachnid – Peter ParkerFighterMobilitySensoryCrowd ControlBArachnid – Miles MoralesFighterMobilitySensoryStealthCrowd ControlBCindy MoonPage coming soonJessica DrewPage coming soonKaine ParkerPage coming soonMiguel OharaPage coming soon

docs.title: Obtaining an Arachnid Power
docs.text:
• When a radioactive spider attacks you, there is a 5% chance you will gain the Arachnid Poisoning effect.
  • The effect can be cleared by drinking milk or by dying.
  • If it is not cleared, you keep it until you sleep in a bed for the night.
  • When you wake up, you will have one of the Arachnid powers, chosen at random.

docs.title: Arachnid Abilities
docs.text:
Spider-like senses and mobility for getting around, climbing and avoiding danger.

Detect any danger within 20 blocks of you. Players that deal damage to you also trigger your spider sense for up to 10 seconds after they hit you. The direction the danger is coming from is shown by the angle of the color displayed on your screen.

Range 20 blocksTrigger on hit 10 seconds

Using your enhanced mobility, dodge in the direction you are moving to avoid incoming damage.

Direction Where you move

Crouch while sprinting to slide, knocking back entities in your path. You can also double jump by pressing the jump key while in the air.

Slide Crouch while sprintingDouble jump Jump in air

By enhancing the inter-atomic attractive forces between your skin and a surface, you sharply increase friction to stick to and climb any surface. Wall Crawling can be toggled on and off with a key bind.

Toggle Key bind

Using your enhanced strength, and with empty main and off hands, carry the target in front of you.

Requires Empty hands

docs.title: Stealth
docs.text:
Turn invisible to those around you.

Fully become invisible to those around you at will. You can stay invisible for 15 seconds, with a cooldown of 3 seconds after releasing it.

Duration 15 secondsCooldown 3 seconds

After using the Dodge ability, become invisible for 3 seconds.

Trigger After DodgeDuration 3 seconds

Turn almost completely invisible to those around you whenever your Spider Sense is going off, so long as there are no other living entities within 3 blocks of you.

Trigger Spider Sense activeRequires No entities within 3 blocks

docs.title: Venom
docs.text:
Guard against incoming damage and strike back with Venom energy.

Guard up to 10 damage from the direction you are looking. Having your guard broken locks it out for 3 seconds.

Guards Up to 10 damageLockout 3 seconds

Concentrate your bioelectric energy into one hand and shock any target you hit with your bare hand.

Effect ShockRequires Bare hand

Using an explosion of Venom energy, leap in the direction you are looking, shocking all entities within a 3 block radius of you for 5 seconds when you do.

Radius 3 blocksShock 5 seconds

Smash your Venom-enabled hands into the ground, knocking all entities around you back and shocking them for 8 seconds.

Effect KnockbackShock 8 seconds

docs.title: Bioelectricity
docs.text:
Enhanced bioelectricity, powered by an energy bar that refills passively over time.

Launch a blast of blue bioelectricity at a target within 5 blocks of you. It then jumps to the nearest target within 10 blocks, up to 3 times total, shocking each target it hits.

Range 5 blocksJump range 10 blocksJumps 3 total

Fire off your blue bioelectricity to all entities within a 4 block radius to pull them towards you.

Radius 4 blocksEffect Pull

Focus your bioelectricity to form a blade of lightning in your hand. While enabled, you have the sweeping edge effect with this blade, +4 damage output, and shock applied to those hit.

Damage +4Effect Sweeping edge · Shock

Fire a Venom-charged attack of blue bioelectricity that launches, then holds the target in place. Any other entity that gets within 2 blocks of the galvanized target becomes shocked.

Effect Holds target in placeShock radius 2 blocks

• This variant has a bioelectricity energy bar which passively refills over time.
  • This power is based on Miles Gonzalo Morales, aka Spider-Man.

docs.text:
Being one of the Spider-Totems connects you to the Web of Life and Destiny.

Detect any danger within 20 blocks of you. Players that deal damage to you also trigger your spider sense for up to 10 seconds after they hit you. The direction the danger is coming from is shown by the angle of the color displayed on your screen.

Range 20 blocksTrigger on hit 10 seconds

Passively sense any spider, or player with an Arachnid-type power, within 20 blocks of you, even through walls. You can also walk through Cobwebs without any issue.

Range 20 blocksPassive Always on

Channel the powers of the Great Weaver to grant all arachnids within 10 blocks (including yourself) Regeneration II.

Range 10 blocksEffect Regeneration IIDuration 5 seconds

docs.title: Arachnid Movement
docs.text:
Enhanced mobility for getting around quickly and climbing anything.

Crouch while sprinting to slide, knocking back entities in your path. You can also double jump by pressing the jump key while in the air.

Slide Crouch while sprintingDouble jump Jump in air

By enhancing the inter-atomic attractive forces between your skin and a surface, you sharply increase friction to stick to and climb any surface. Wall Crawling can be toggled on and off with a key bind.

Toggle Key bind

docs.title: Arachnid Physiology
docs.text:
Your mutated body makes you stronger and tougher.

Using your enhanced strength, and with empty main and off hands, carry the target in front of you.

Requires Empty hands

Your mutation causes your bones to become tougher, so the damage you take from falling is reduced to only 5%.

Fall damage 5%

Your mutation causes your muscles to become tougher.

Attack damage +2 (permanent)

Your mutation causes your skin to become denser.

Armor rating +4 (permanent)

Your mutation causes your skin to become tougher.

docs.title: Organic Webbing
docs.text:
Webbing produced by your own body. It draws on your Organic Webbing and costs no Web Fluid. This is one of the few Arachnid powers with organic webs, the other being Silk.

Fire a Web-Line at any block to pull yourself towards it. Firing at another entity pulls that entity towards you instead.

Block Pulls youEntity Pulls it to you

Create Organic Webbing to swing from. It is turned off by default, and you can switch to the assisted or freeform swing modes with the "Swing Mode Change" ability.

Default OffModes Assisted · Freeform

Fire small shots of Organic Webbing, alternating from each arm, to deal low damage and give your target the Webbed effect. Unlike the Web-Shooters, this costs no Web Fluid.

Damage LowEffect Webbed IIIDuration 5 seconds

Having refined your Organic Webbing further, fire a larger shot to deal more damage, knock your target back, and give them the Webbed effect. Costs no Web Fluid.

Damage HigherKnockback YesEffect Webbed VIDuration 10 seconds

Having pushed your Arachnid Mutation to its next stage, launch yourself into the air and spin rapidly, unleashing a burst of Organic Webbing in every direction to overwhelm and restrain those around you. Costs no Web Fluid.

Launch Into the airBurst Every direction

docs.title: Arachnid Mutation
docs.text:
Extended time with mutated D.N.A. unlocks newly acquired capabilities.

Because you are one of the Spider-Totems, connected to the Web of Life and Destiny, all Spiders and Cave Spiders will ignore you.

Affects Spiders · Cave Spiders

Your powers are facing an emergence of newly acquired capabilities. When your health is below 50%, you gain increased attack damage but also begin to automatically attack anything within 5 blocks of you.

Health Below 50%Attack damage +2Auto-attack 5 blocks

Your arachnid-based abilities develop further. In addition to Organic Emergence, your spider sense becomes much more accurate at telling where entities around you are, at the cost of your senses being overloaded when it is activated in your mutated state, until mastered.

Spider Sense More accurateDrawback Sensory overload until mastered

Having spent even more time with mutated D.N.A., your arachnid-based abilities develop further. When your health is below 50%, you gain increased attack knockback in addition to automatically attacking anything within 5 blocks of you.

Health Below 50%Attack knockback +2Auto-attack 5 blocks

docs.title: Relevant Information
docs.text:
• This is one of the few Arachnids that have organic webs. The other is Silk.
  • This power is based on Peter Parker, aka Spider-Man.

docs.title: Mutants
docs.text:
Mutants are individuals in the Marvel Universe who possess the X-gene, a genetic trait that grants them extraordinary abilities, often manifesting during adolescence or periods of extreme stress. Their powers vary widely, ranging from enhanced physical abilities and elemental manipulation to telepathy, shapeshifting, and reality warping.

Reality WarpingOffenseDefenseManipulationArea ControlPsychicSensoryMobilityVersatileUtilityS

docs.title: Reality Warping
docs.text:
Main Power · Marvel · Mutants Reality Warping Power ranking S S Tier Source Biological Powers that are genetic-based. Reality Warping is unlocked through the X-Gene. Power classificationOffenseDefenseManipulationArea ControlPsychicSensoryMobilityVersatileUtility Obtained fromX-GeneRandom Chance Ability categoriesPsionic ManipulationEnergy ManipulationSpatial ManipulationReality ManipulationCosmic Manipulation Signature lookBlue EnergyBeams, Projectiles and more

Reality Warping is an extraordinary power that allows the user to manipulate and reshape reality, drawing on psionic, energy, spatial, reality, and cosmic powers. It grants abilities such as telepathy, telekinesis, energy projection, dimensional travel, matter alteration, and environmental transformation, making it an extremely versatile power with both offensive and defensive abilities.

docs.text:
Reality Warping has five ability categories. Jump to one:

Psionic Manipulation Energy Manipulation Spatial Manipulation Reality Manipulation Cosmic Manipulation

docs.title: Psionic Manipulation
docs.text:
Use your Telepathy or Telekinesis via various methods.

Directly attack a target's mind within 6 blocks. This will deal 4 Psionic damage to the target when hit.

Range 6 blocksDamage 4 Psionic

Use your telepathic reach to reveal the information of Entities around you in a 30 block radius. If you are using Cerebro to enhance your abilities, you will also be able to read any powers targets in range have.

Radius 30 blocks

Use your telepathic reach to see through another target's eyes. You will be able to hop up to 3 times into different targets.

Hops up to 3

Telekinetically grab any entity or block within 8 blocks of you. Scrolling while this is enabled will allow you to bring the target closer or further.

Range 8 blocks

Telekinetically repel all targets within 3 blocks of you away from you.

Radius 3 blocks

Lift, then launch up to 5 blocks within a 6 block radius of you at your target for 4 damage per hit.

Blocks up to 5Radius 6 blocksDamage 4 per hit

docs.title: Energy Manipulation
docs.text:
Use your power to manipulate different energies in various ways.

Dip into your ability to rewrite reality to convert any item in your mainhand into its multiversal counterpart, if it has any.

Use some of your energy to register items within your mental database. This will consume the item being registered, and will not retain any enchantments / nbt data. Items entered in the Argon mod's config file blacklist cannot be saved for creation.

Use some of your energy to create items within your mental database. Once registered, each item has a max of 5 times it can be created before needing to be re-registered in your mental database.

Creates per registration 5

Manipulate your energy to fire off a beam of raw reality energy.

Manipulate your energy to create a shield of raw reality energy in front of you. With this shield, you will be able to block up to 50 damage in front of you before it breaks.

Blocks up to 50 damage

Manipulate the energy inside you by charging it up for 5 seconds, then exploding it out of you harming everything within a 5 block radius of you.

Charge 5 secondsRadius 5 blocks

docs.title: Spatial Manipulation
docs.text:
Use your power to manipulate the space around you, and gain mastery over it.

Fold the distance between you and a location up to 15 blocks in the direction you are looking to appear there instantly.

Distance up to 15 blocks

Tap into the power of your Pocket Dimension to store up to 32 items in a controlled space that only you have access to.

Capacity 32 items

Create a small portal to send yourself to your Pocket Dimension. Using this ability while in the Pocket Dimension will return you to where you were when you left.

Gain the ability to open a menu to create portals that allow you and others to travel throughout different dimensions.

docs.title: Reality Manipulation
docs.text:
Use your power to shape and manipulate the reality around you.

Using the item(s) in your mainhand, convert it into anything that uses it as a crafting material. You will need the amount of said item used in that attempted item's crafting recipe to reconstruct it.

Alter the reality of a targeted block to change the blockstate of any block you are looking at between any of its available states.

Select an area to alter into a compact item. Placing the item on a block will return it to its full size.

Transform reality around you in a 12 block radius to that of a random biome. Those who are caught in the dome with you will not be able to escape / break any blocks until the ability is released. Based on the biome you changed to, have the following effects granted to all within the altered reality:

Radius 12 blocks Plains RegenerationDesert HungerSnowy Taiga FreezeDripstone Caves Fire resistanceDeep Dark BlindnessNether Wastes BurningSoul Sand Valley WitherBasalt Deltas WeaknessEnd Barrens Saturation

docs.title: Cosmic Manipulation
docs.text:
Use your power to manipulate the Power Cosmic around you.

Enter a meditative state to passively pull in Cosmic energy from around you to rapidly regenerate your reality energy bar, and create a light source around you. You will not be able to move, and your flight speed will be reduced by 90% while this ability is enabled, and you will also take 2x damage from all sources.

Flight speed -90%Damage taken 2x

At the cost of a significant amount of your stored energy, grant the target you are looking at the Cosmic Awakening effect which can grant them access to the abilities of your Cosmic Herald.

Drain your Reality Energy to grant the Regeneration, Resistance and Strength effects on all Heralds within a 20 block radius. This will also grant the Wither Effect to all non-heralds within a 10 block radius.

Heralds 20 blocksNon-heralds 10 blocks

Drain your Reality Energy to slow all targets within a 5 block radius around you, using your Cosmic Energy to deal damage to them over time.

Radius 5 blocks

docs.title: Relevant Information
docs.text:
• This power is loosely based on Franklin Richards, a.k.a. Powerhouse.
  • Cerebro gives buffs to telepathic abilities when worn.
  • This power is one of the two powers that can travel other dimensions.

There are 4 abilities that add boosts to you when you are in the Pocket Dimension:

Pocket Dimension: Healing+2 HP / 2 Secs Pocket Dimension: Health+6 HP Pocket Dimension: Energy Gain+30 Energy / Sec Pocket Dimension: Saturation+1 Saturation / 3 Secs

docs.title: Power Classifications
docs.text:
Every power on this wiki is tagged with one or more power classifications. They show up as the colored pills in the Power classification row of each power's overview card. This page explains what each one means.

How to read them

A power can have several classifications. A classification describes what the power is mainly good at, not everything it can do.

docs.title: All classifications
docs.text: Offense Defense Fighter Heavy Hitter Tank Mobility Crowd Control Area Control Manipulation Negation Utility Sensory Stealth Psychic Versatile Support Survivability Transformation

docs.title: Combat
docs.text: How a power fights: dealing damage, taking it, or both.

docs.title: Offense
docs.text: Deals damage through direct attacks, ranged attacks, or large-scale destruction.

docs.title: Defense
docs.text: Prevents or reduces incoming damage through protection, resistance, barriers, or damage negation.

docs.title: Fighter
docs.text: Excels in direct combat, combining offensive capabilities with combat-oriented abilities.

docs.title: Heavy Hitter
docs.text: Specializes in delivering exceptionally high damage through powerful attacks or devastating bursts of damage.

docs.title: Tank
docs.text: Excels at absorbing sustained damage and surviving combat through high durability or defensive abilities.

docs.title: Movement & Control
docs.text: Getting around, and deciding where enemies can go and what they can do.

docs.title: Mobility
docs.text: Enhances movement through flight, teleportation, dashing, wall-crawling, or dimensional travel.

docs.title: Crowd Control
docs.text: Restricts or disrupts enemy actions through immobilization, slowing, stunning, or other disabling effects.

docs.title: Area Control
docs.text: Controls specific zones of the battlefield using persistent effects, hazards, barriers, or area denial.

docs.title: Manipulation
docs.text: Controls, alters, or redirects existing matter, energy, forces, or phenomena, including environmental and physical elements.

docs.title: Negation
docs.text: Suppresses, disables, or removes powers, abilities, or specific effects.

docs.title: Utility & Awareness
docs.text: Tools, senses, secrecy and the mind.

docs.title: Utility
docs.text: Provides practical functions beyond direct combat, such as item creation, storage, or environmental interaction.

docs.title: Sensory
docs.text: Enhances perception, detects threats, or reveals otherwise inaccessible information.

docs.title: Stealth
docs.text: Avoids detection through invisibility, concealment, disguise, or suppression of presence.

docs.title: Psychic
docs.text: Interacts with minds or mental processes through telepathy, mind reading, mental projection, or other psychic abilities.

docs.title: Versatile
docs.text: Offers a broad range of different capabilities that serve multiple purposes.

docs.title: Support & Survival
docs.text: Helping allies, staying alive, and changing form.

docs.title: Support
docs.text: Assists allies through healing, buffs, shared abilities, or protective effects.

docs.title: Survivability
docs.text: Improves the user's ability to survive threats through regeneration, absorption of damage or energy, intangibility, or other survival-enhancing abilities.

docs.title: Transformation
docs.text: Changes the user's form, appearance, physical properties, or state to gain different capabilities.

docs.title: Using them on a power page
docs.text:
In a power overview card, use one <i> per classification. The class name is c- plus the name in lowercase, with a hyphen for spaces:

<div><span>Power classification</span><b class="pc-types"><i class="c-fighter">Fighter</i><i class="c-mobility">Mobility</i><i class="c-crowd-control">Crowd Control</i></b></div>

The icon and color come from the class, so the pill looks the same on every page.
